{"metadata":{"type":"page"},"title":"📄 Wire Tension Indicator with IoT","url":"https://app.notion.com/p/c2c3dd29567d83bb9ed98106a68a3de7","text":"Here is the result of "view" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/c2c3dd29567d83bb9ed98106a68a3de7 as of 2026-07-17T19:02:26.227Z: {"title":"Wire Tension Indicator with IoT"} # Wire Tension Indicator (WTI) The WTI series is a digital tension measurement device designed to provide the perfect solution for measuring and monitoring online tension on a product during various industrial processes. This device combines a precision strain gauge with a high-resolution tension indicator, serving as the ideal fit for customers aiming for superior product quality. ### Key Characteristics - Digital Indicator for high-speed measurements. - Unique design for multiple applications. - Special coating for easy flow of material on guides. ## Features & Benefits ### Features - Dynamically balanced special quoted pulleys. - Datalogger option for monitoring and analysing data. - Analog output suitable for process control application. - Digital output for alarm integration. - Industry 4.0 compliant. - Flexibility to customise design as per requirements. ### Benefits - Easy integration with the exiting process. - Easy diagnosis with accurate data. - High longevity. - No maintenance. ## Technical Specification
**Model** **WTI-90-40** **WTI-100-40**
**Size of Wire** 0.2-5mm 2-10mm
**Tension range** 40Kg/15Kg 40Kg/15Kg
**Supply** 24VDC 24VDC
**Analogue Output** 0-10VDC/4-20mA 0-10VDC/4-20mA
**Digital Output** Transistor output (Optional) Transistor output (Optional)
**Communication** RS485 MODBUS (Optional) RS485 MODBUS (Optional)
## Process Overview & Schematic **Process Components:**The system includes elements such as Extruder, Buncher, Stranding, Twister, Wire Drawing, Laying, Monitor, Printer, Hard Drive, Die, Lub Bath, Keyboard, Pick Up Spool, Motor, Traverse Table, and Traverse Motion Motor. **Image Descriptions:** - **Image 1:** Schematic of a wire tension measurement device integrated into an industrial assembly line, featuring wire pathing through a tensioner and guide pulleys. - **Image 2:** Diagram of the "Laying" process showing wire input through a tensioning unit to a spooling mechanism. - **Image 3:** Comprehensive assembly line diagram showing wire passing through various stations including tension control, drawing, and spooling units. - **Image 4:** Schematic for industrial line configuration showing material intake, tensioning, and output stages. - **Image 5:** Detailed "Wire Drawing" process schematic highlighting the integration of a monitor, printer, hard drive, keyboard, lubrication bath, die, and the traverse table system. ## Applications

## Why Industry Needs It & Solution In today's automation era, material travel length has increased due to multiple processes. This approach impacts product quality against the ignorance of various process parameters. The WTI addresses one of these key process parameters—ONLINE TENSION—for the continuous manufacturing industry. In continuous production processes, the quality of the finished products is directly dependent on the accurate measurement and monitoring of the material tension. Thus, this improves finished product quality, reduces wastage, increases processing speeds, maximizes machine efficiency, and reduces downtime. ## Communication & Network The LASER 2008 series offers multiple integration options through different ways in order to fulfill requirements like remote monitoring and data logging, which are essential parts of manufacturing. With default communications output, the product is compliant with INDUSTRY 4.0 standards, thus meeting the new growing needs of the customer. ## HMI Extension All the LASER 2008 series gauges are compatible with custom-made PC-based software which communicates deeper insights to the user. A user-friendly software with simple run menus and instinctive access to functions and data display generates trendy results and logs critical product measurement data. **\[Image Description: Wire Diameter Measurement System with Data Logger\]**The HMI interface displays a "Wire Diameter Measurement System with Data Logger" with a current reading of 65.535.
